description: Header file defining classes and functions related to scoped wakelocks in Android sensors HAL, including the ScopedWakelock class and IScopedWakelockRefCounter interface.

classes.name: IScopedWakelockRefCounter
classes.description: Interface for managing wakelock reference counting and acquisition/release logic.

classes.name: ScopedWakelock
classes.description: RAII-style class managing the lifecycle of a wakelock within a scope.

methods.name: incrementRefCountAndMaybeAcquireWakelock
methods.description: Increments the wakelock ref count and acquires the wakelock if needed.

methods.name: decrementRefCountAndMaybeReleaseWakelock
methods.description: Decrements the wakelock ref count and releases the wakelock if ref count reaches zero.

methods.name: getTimeNow
methods.description: Returns the current time in nanoseconds.
